author: Joshua Fluke
description:
Job applications in 2026 are becoming completely insane.

Candidates are being asked to perform onstage in front of judges, complete personality tests, hand over social-media information, answer invasive personal questions, disclose salary expectations before companies reveal their own pay range, provide biometric information and jump through increasingly ridiculous hoops just for a chance at getting hired.

And somehow employers are still complaining that candidates aren't sending enough thank-you emails.

In this video, we're looking at how ridiculous the modern hiring process has become.

Companies are experimenting with competition-style recruiting where applicants pitch themselves and business ideas onstage in front of judges and hundreds of people. title: JOB INTERVIEW COMPETITIONS ARE HERE!!
